regimeSub: SPX grinds +0.3% as Russia sanction waiver keeps Brent capped at $110; 10Y pushes to 5.15% on term premium.
themes: Trump Russia sanction waiver per Reuters Oct 19 keeps Brent at $110.51 vs $112 peak → energy secretary Rubio Oct 18 defends move as 'not a lifeline'; oil futures pullback per WSJ Oct 19 sustains risk bid despite bipartisan pushback

10Y Treasury climbs 6bp to 5.15% per Morningstar bond selloff narrative Oct 19 → 2Y +3bp to 4.77% maintains steep curve; French/Italian protest-driven selloff per Guardian Oct 19 adds EU contagion to term premium

Fed Chair Warsh 'worst yet to come' warning per Motley Fool Oct 19 keeps Dec hike live → Reuters Oct 20 poll shows nearly all economists expect Oct skip then Dec hike; Sep CPI 4.0% vs 3.7% prior cements inflation overhang
KOSPI rebounds to 5772 (+2.7% from Oct 15 lows) as HBM peak-out fears stabilize → BOK Rhee Oct 12 'data-dependent' stance leaves Nov decision open; USDKRW -0.15% to 1326 as won firms on risk-on tilt

headline: Russia sanction waiver caps oil upside and extends risk reprieve as 10Y breaches 5.15%, with Fed Chair Warsh signaling Dec hike likely and Sep CPI at 4.0% keeping stagflation fears on simmer.
